cohort: Low-risk women undergoing elective cesarean delivery at term
finding: Antibiotic chemoprophylaxis did not reduce the risk of postoperative infection in low-risk women undergoing elective cesarean delivery at term but significantly increased the cost of hospitalization.
mod_finding: This study focuses on the efficacy of antibiotic prophylaxis in women undergoing elective cesarean delivery and does not compare it to other modes of delivery.
